security_concerns.component: Existing dev-image Jansson 2.14 dependency; not established as a commit regression
security_concerns.finding: Allocator-failure injection into parsing the newly accepted synthetic accounting shape crashes instead of returning NULL. Combined observer sweep reached allocation index 211 then normal SIGSEGV and ASan invalid-free in json_loadb. Direct json_loads-only sweep, with no observer invocation, independently reached index 109 then ASan SEGV inside libjansson.
security_concerns.impact: Memory-pressure robustness is not verified; whole-gateway availability can be affected by dependency allocation failure. No remote exploit or real-OOM reproduction claimed.
security_concerns.recommendation: Track and isolate dependency OOM failure before claiming unconditional fail-closed OOM safety; assess patched Jansson separately. No installation or implementation modification performed.

summary: Actual-provider text SSE compatibility and complete normal/sanitizer suites pass; overall fail-closed review is withheld because the optional deeper parsing-OOM sweep exposed a reproducible existing dependency crash.
checks: Independent static diff review, AGENTS.md, review and routing skills read; git diff --check 51edafd 27c1c04 exited 0.
Fresh git archive snapshots, no reliance on prior binaries. Full CTest normal 18/18; full ASan/UBSan CTest 18/18, leak detection enabled.

Both actual authorized wirefiles normalize exactly to READY at every split and 1/37-byte fragments under both builds. Original 37-byte observer also confirms portable=true/observer_failed=false. Fresh baseline observer rejects both: portable=false/observer_failed=true, exit 1.

Committed rejection tests exercised unknown/empty/delimiter/duplicate keys, changing provider, malformed native/normalized finish, post-finish text/tool/reasoning/opaque state, missing/early/duplicate DONE, duplicate accounting tails, nonfinite and negative costs, invalid BYOK and nested token details.
Independent synthetic UTF-8/CRLF every split (1269) and 200 deterministic arbitrary-fragment streams pass normal and ASan.

No new production JSON serialization callsites introduced. Supplementary normalized-message json_pack failure sweep passes all 8 allocation positions under normal and ASan, each injected failure returns NULL.

Additional combined parsing OOM sweep fails; parser-only reproducer establishes dependency involvement rather than observer state-machine logic. Overall passed=false conservatively; compatibility_passed=true is narrower.
